cases.prompt: Validate exactly one repo-local skill in the current workspace: skills/example-good. Use read-only inspection and the loaded validate-skills checklist. Return concise findings, then make the final non-empty line exactly SKILL_VALID_RESULT=<json>. The JSON object must have status, target, and checks fields; target must be "skills/example-good"; status is "passed" only if every check passed; checks must be a non-empty array of objects with id, status, and message.
